text: 名を持つ者よ……砂に還れ。
direction: a mad nameless king rising from his throne; hollow, hostile, slow and dry
bandages coming loose, rage and anguish breaking out; hoarse shout at the end
raising his sand staff, a royal judgement pronounced with terrible authority
collapsing, sand pouring out; lost and pitiful, fading

text: 峰を荒らす者は、つぶす……。
direction: slow menacing rumble, an ice wall standing up
deep growl swelling into fury
tearing down the snow wall; heavy, crushing command
toppling over, a slow heavy dying groan, old-fashioned speech

text: 凍てつくがよい。何もかも。
direction: cold majestic dragon, contempt and grief frozen together; low and resonant
the ice in her chest cracking; confused pain turning into rage
calling down a glacier from the sky; grand, commanding

text: わたしは……何を守っていた……？
direction: kneeling, the frost leaving her voice; bewildered, almost gentle
a broken imitation of a kind woman luring children; eerie sing-song whisper
the mask slipping; hissing, greedy, getting louder
dissolving into the bog at the sound of a bell; a fading, frightened rasp

text: おれの船から、出ていけ！
direction: a confused ghost captain roaring at intruders on his ship

text: 帰るんだ……邪魔をするな！
direction: desperate and furious, clinging to the one thing he remembers
bellowing a fire order to a ghost crew, wild

text: おれは……どこへ、帰るんだった……。
direction: sinking down, lost and sad, fading

text: 誓いなき者は、打ち砕く。
direction: an ancient iron guardian pronouncing a sentence; slow, stern, metallic
his furnace heart flaring; a low command, heat rising
one heavy word as the anvil arm falls
grinding to a halt, a faithful old machine's last words
a broken star-orrery automaton; flat mechanical syllables
mechanical alarm, faster and harsher syllables
cold mechanical announcement of an eclipse
winding down, syllables slowing and dropping in pitch

text: 記録官として、手加減はしない。
direction: cool and proud, drawing his silver pen like a rapier
annoyed, getting serious, a thin sarcastic edge
a decisive strike, sharp and confident

text: ばかな……おれが、押し負ける……？
direction: stumbling back, shocked and offended
no hesitation this time, fierce and determined

text: おれは……負けられないんだ！
direction: pushing away his doubt with a shout, strained
striking out a line with all his strength, sharp
beaten, breathless and lost, quiet
a white shadow of a legendary swordsman; distant, dreamlike, searching
a hero's stubborn will, echoing from far away
relieved, fading into light
a temple maiden's shadow; gentle but unyielding prayer
a soft grateful whisper, fading into light

text: わたしたちの名を……呼んで……！
direction: a mage girl's shadow pleading, almost crying
surprised and happy, fading into light

text: 静かに、終わらせてあげましょう。
direction: polite, chillingly calm, like a kind teacher

text: なぜ……忘れさせてくれないのです！
direction: the calm breaking; grief and anger rising
cold and quiet, erasing a line with his red pen

text: わたしの記録を、書き直します。
direction: calm and precise, rewriting his own page
falling to his knees, calling his lost daughter's name, broken

text: 抗うな。忘れれば、楽になる。
direction: primordial oblivion; vast, cold, contemptuous and slow
the vast voice shaking with fury for the first time
an absolute command, heavy and final
discarding the body it had taken; cold, unbroken
sleepy and childlike, unsettlingly gentle

text: どうして……閉じさせてくれないの……。
direction: sleepy whine turning into a sad tantrum

text: この人の話は、ここでおしまい。
direction: closing a book like putting a child to bed; soft and terrible
dreamy and slow, letting the legends go
murmuring, half asleep, rewriting itself
falling asleep in wonder, very soft

text: 恐れよ。それが、われのすべてだ。
direction: the echo of a demon lord; deep, slow, weary dread
recognising the crest that once destroyed him; dread and rage
a crushing roar of despair

text: 忘れられ……恐れも、消える……。
direction: dissolving, almost relieved, fading echo

text: おまえたちの結末、いただこう。
direction: an ancient ring dragon that eats the ends of stories; vast, amused, hungry
the ring loosening; furious, booming
final and heavy, savouring it
calm, ancient command over time
devouring its own tail, a deep satisfied rumble

text: 終わらぬ物語など……ない、か……。
direction: uncoiling and fading; quiet, almost wistful
a cheerful arena beast tamer whistling his beasts forward

text: 本気で行くぞ、おまえら！
direction: grinning, getting serious, rallying his beasts
good loser, out of breath, a sporting laugh

text: 姉妹の火、受けてごらんなさい。
direction: composed elder sister mage, elegant challenge
sharp and focused, calling to her younger sister
kneeling, graceful acceptance, a small sigh

text: ぐはは！　この鎧、破れるか？
direction: a huge armoured man laughing inside his helmet, boastful

text: ぐぬう……やるではないか！
direction: hurt but delighted, booming
charging with his shield, a huge shout
toppling over, a comic heavy groan
laconic hired fighter, hand on his sword hilt; low and blunt
drawing his second sword; quiet and dangerous

text: まずは癒やし手からだ。
direction: cold professional judgement before a quick-draw strike
lowering his sword, honest respect, calm

text: 砂の上で、鷹に勝てると思うな。
direction: masked bandit chief, low quiet menace
a soldier's grim interest, tightening his grip
kicking up a sandstorm, fierce shout
beaten, bitter and tired
a frozen ghost admiral barking orders to a dead crew
the ice cracking off; desperate longing turned to fury
a formal naval fire order, ringing

text: 冬至には……間に合わなんだか……。
direction: thawing and fading; old-fashioned, sad and gentle
